name: Snake Salve, Greater
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot none; Price 2,000 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

Similar to snake salve, this paste activates a greater magic fang spell upon the target snake.

When creating this salve the creator may decide to create one dose which lasts 5 hours or five doses, each lasting one hour.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang; Cost 1,000 gp.
